An unknown or consumed id exits 1; empty evidence exits 10
fix: Add `evolve inbox verify <id> --evidence T`. On a pending item it stamps premise_verified_at (now), premise_verified_sha (origin/main's HEAD) and the evidence text, through the lifecycle's stamp writer with a ledger line, the way route-console stamps a route. An unknown or non-pending id exits 1; empty evidence exits 10. Reading the stamp in the drift computation belongs to premise-verification-anchor; this request adds the writer. Document it in runtime-reference.md's operator commands.
source: console, 2026-09-30, core-function CLI inventory (operator request: a CLI request for each core function)
summary: Premise drift is measured from the item's filing time, so an item the console re-checks and re-queues shows the same drift forever and can bounce between a lane's stale drop and the console. Inbox premise-verification-anchor designs a premise_verified_at field for this, but nothing writes such a stamp: re-verifying an item today means editing its JSON by hand.
title: A console premise re-verification cannot be recorded on an item, so its premise drift never resets; add `evolve inbox verify`
